title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
【精灵：杰尼龟】【性别：雌】【特性：激流】【资质：蓝色】【个体值：HP（18）攻击（20）特攻（21）防御（25）特防（24）速度（16）】【实力：5~8级】【技能：撞击，摇尾巴，水枪，缩入壳中】【介绍：一只怨气爆棚的杰尼龟，它似乎在想，自己是不是跟错了训练家，想到以后都要这么早起来，就崩溃了....】【亲密度：20（你让它休息了起来）】【愉悦值：-15（宝可梦和宝可梦之间的差距并不相同，它很羡慕现在的藤藤蛇）】看着这只杰尼龟的信息。林枫的面色更加怪异了。好家伙。看不出心理活动还挺多....“对呀，对呀，都是初始宝可梦，虽然水系被草系克制，但我相信，在我精妙绝伦的指挥下，我的杰尼龟肯定能击败...和你的藤藤蛇打成平手！”秦姝挥了挥小拳头，一脸的自信。“呃...那好吧？”林枫觉得，自己应该打击一下她，。两只宝可梦都是初始宝可梦，但他得让对方清楚，初始宝可梦之间，亦有着天差地别一般的差距。开什么玩笑。差了十级，再加上还有属性克制。如果这藤藤蛇还打不过的话，林枫真要检查一下藤藤蛇是不是身体有什么问题了。两人很快来到外面的青石小道上，两只初始宝可梦，技能对地形地貌的破坏还不严重，所以，随便找个空旷的地方便能对战。“杰尼龟，这可是我们经历的第一场对战，一定要好好打，打出风采，这样我们在宝宝杯上，才能获取一个好成绩，知道吗？”一路上，秦姝不断的给杰尼龟加油打气。而杰尼龟的反应却很有意思。它一直盯着藤藤蛇，大大的卡姿兰眼睛中，带着几分寻求。“杰尼，杰尼...”（你这训练家哪里找的，挺好的呀？帮我也找一个？）藤藤蛇：...它没想到，这只杰尼龟，居然是一个这样的逗比...只是翻了一个白眼，便高冷的走在林枫身边。没有对比，就看不出差距。这个人类，看起来确确实实有点憨憨，不太聪明的样子。

相较之而言，林枫实在是好多了。这样想着，藤藤蛇忍不住嘴角微微上扬。青石小道上，两人站好位置。“准备好了吗？”在秦姝热烈赤诚的询问下，林枫微微点头。“好，我们上，杰尼龟，使用撞击！”杰尼龟此刻的表情也认真了起来，虽然抱怨归抱怨，但还是很听训练家的指令，在听到指令后，顶着一个光滑程亮的大光头，向着藤藤蛇撞去。不得不说，经过跑步训练的杰尼龟，速度好像还真不慢的样子。如果愿意抬起头，就更好了。林枫实在想不明白，为什么使用撞击绝招，不肯抬起头？藤藤蛇的目光仍旧平淡罢了。“嗯...藤藤蛇，你轻点？”看着在旁边丝毫未动的藤藤蛇，林枫忍不住劝说了一句。“藤藤...”（听你的...）藤藤蛇摊开小手，表示自己都无所谓。“那好，藤藤蛇，使用藤鞭！”林枫手指一挥，心中竟也激发了几分豪气。平日中虽然见过太多场次的宝可梦对战，但真到实际上，他也难免的有些意动。“藤藤....”藤藤蛇琥珀般的眼眸流转起来，看着撞击过来连头也不抬的杰尼龟，莫名的有些想笑。它只是轻微的侧过身去，然后杰尼龟就从它的身边擦肩而过，甚至不知道自己已经离目标越来越远了....当两根藤鞭落在它脚下的时候，它这才反应过来，想要躲避。但似乎巨大的惯性，已经不足以让它躲开这招藤鞭了....砰！脑袋和青石巨大的碰撞声，让一旁的林枫忍不住“啧啧”了一声...这声音，好清脆...有种“好听就是好头的错觉”。“藤藤...”藤藤蛇小手扶了一下额头，突然意识到两者为什么能走到一起了...有什么样的训练家，就有什么样的宝可梦呀！“杰尼龟！？”
content_en:
[Elf: Squirtle] [Gender: Female] [Characteristics: Riptide] [Qualification: Blue] [Individual value: HP (18) Attack (20) Special Attack (21) Defense (25) Special Defense (24) Speed (16)] [Strength: Level 5~8] [Skills: Impact, tail wagging, water gun, shrinking into a shell] [Introduction: A resentful oneSquirtle, it seemed to be wondering if it was with the wrong trainer, and collapsed when it thought of having to get up so early in the future...] [Intimacy: 20 (you let it rest)] [Pleasure value: -15 (The gap between Pokémon and Pokémon is not the same, it is very envious of the current Vine Snake)] looked at the information of this Squirtle.Lin Feng's expression became even weirder.Good guy.There is a lot of mental activity... "Yes, yes, they are all starter Pokémon. Although the water type is restrained by the grass type, I believe that under my exquisite command, my Squirtle will definitely be able to defeat... and tie with your Vine Snake!" Qin Shu waved her fist, looking confident."Uh... okay?" Lin Feng felt that he should give her a blow.Both Pokémon are starter Pokémon, but he has to let the other party know that there are also huge differences between the starter Pokémon.What a joke.The difference is ten levels, plus there are attribute restraints.If the Vine Snake still can't be beaten, Lin Feng really wants to check if there is anything wrong with the Vine Snake's health.The two quickly came to the bluestone path outside. The two starter Pokémon's skills did not cause serious damage to the terrain, so they could find an open place to battle."Squirtle, this is our first game. We must play well and show our style, so that we can get a good result in the Baby Cup, you know?" Qin Shu kept cheering Squirtle along the way.But Squirtle’s reaction is very interesting.It has been staring at the Vine Snake, with a bit of seeking in its big eyes."Jenny, Jenny..." (Where did you find this trainer? Is it good? Find one for me?) Vine Snake: ...It didn't expect that this Squirtle would be such a funny guy... He just rolled his eyes and walked coldly beside Lin Feng.Without comparison, there is no difference.This human being does indeed look a bit naive and not very smart.

In comparison, Lin Feng was much better.Thinking like this, Teng Teng Snake couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth slightly.On the bluestone path, the two of them took their positions."Are you ready?" Under Qin Shu's enthusiastic and sincere inquiry, Lin Feng nodded slightly."Okay, let's go, Squirtle, use impact!" Squirtle's expression became serious at this moment. Although he was complaining, he still listened to the trainer's instructions. After hearing the instructions, he hit the vine snake with a smooth and bright bald head.I have to say that after training for running, Squirtle seems to be really not slow.If you are willing to raise your head, even better.Lin Feng really couldn't understand why he refused to raise his head when he used the impact trick?Teng Teng Snake's eyes were still dull."Hmm... Vine Snake, please be gentler?" Lin Feng couldn't help but persuade him as he looked at Vine Snake who didn't move at all."Teng Teng..." (I listen to you...) Teng Teng Snake spread his little hands to show that he didn't care."Okay, Vine Snake, use the Vine Whip!" Lin Feng waved his finger, and a bit of pride aroused in his heart.Although he had seen too many Pokémon battles in his daily life, in reality, he would inevitably be a little moved."Teng Teng..." The amber eyes of the Teng Teng Snake started to flow. Looking at Squirtle who didn't even raise his head after the collision, he felt like laughing inexplicably.It just turned slightly sideways, and then Squirtle passed by it, not even knowing that it was getting further and further away from the target... When two vine whips fell at its feet, it reacted and wanted to avoid it.But it seems that the huge inertia is no longer enough for it to avoid this vine whip... Bang!The huge collision sound between the head and the bluestone made Lin Feng on the side couldn't help but let out a "tsk, tsk"... This sound was so crisp... There was an illusion that "a good sound means a good head"."Tengteng..." Tengteng Snake put his little hand on his forehead, and suddenly realized why the two came together...what kind of trainer there is, what kind of Pokémon is there!"Squirtle!?"
